comments: Oh no I can't repro this on 1.18.931.0. I don't think that had MUX 2.8...

The easiest way to repro this: just add this line

```json
    "tabWidthMode": "titleLength",
```

and comment / uncomment

review_comments: I think we should really start using an observable item collection instead of manipulating the tab view list directly. It might many of the animation bugs we have too...
